notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Unstoppable Slasher
Unstoppable Slasher triggers, causing the defending opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
The opponent dealt combat damage loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

uses.name: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant
